resources.string: Recording with sound. You choose where to keep the video when you stop.
Recording the picture only: sound is off for this session.
Recording the picture only: this session has no sound right now.
Recording stopped because the sound stopped. The video up to that point, with its sound, was kept.
Recording stopped because the sound stopped before anything was recorded.
Recording stopped: its sound could not be lined up with the picture. Record again, or turn sound off for this session to record the picture only.
Recording stopped: this phone could not add the session\'s sound to the video.
The session reconnected, but its AAC sound did not start, so recording did not begin. Record again for the picture only.
This session\'s sound is %1$s, and Android can only put AAC sound in an MP4 video. Reconnecting with AAC takes a moment and changes only this session, not its saved settings.
Recordings include sound with AAC. Other sound asks to reconnect with AAC when you record.
